runtime.title: Smoother sign-on and scrollable navigation
notes: Made fixed desktop navigation scrollable on short windows and at browser zoom, preserving access to lower navigation and account controls.

Improved named sign-on loading screens, titles, fragment cleanup and in-app completion. Existing browser binding, permissions, live source-session checks and linked logout are unchanged. No migration or new secret is required.
